model.name: CR1: Rename 'Champagne Chain' label to 'Traceability Chain' in all user-facing UI.
model.description: CHANGE REQUEST (dogfoods R20.4 ior:class:ChangeRequest): rename every "Champagne" label in the product UI to "Traceability". Scope: (1) src/public/ts/trace/singular-chain.ts:3 — comment says "champagne path" → rename to "traceability chain path". (2) ANY detail-view section heading that renders "Champagne Chain" → "Traceability Chain" (these are generated from the singular-chain module or detail-superseded.ts template strings). (3) grep dist/ for compiled remnants and rebuild. Champagne is the team internal quality-verification concept — users must NEVER see it. Only 1 source file hit (singular-chain.ts:3); the rest are in compiled dist/ (rebuild clears). Self-standing for architect→expert: rename string + rebuild + verify no "champagne" in rendered UI.
model.tronQuote: > TRON: "do you see the issues on this requirement and the need for change requests and bugs regarding traceability and stupid champagne marketing?"
model.crossRefNote: R20.5 (universal chain-vs-children) already specified 'Traceability' as the label. CR1 is the explicit change-request to rename the existing 'Champagne Chain' label.

intendedChain.useCase: detailView.renameChainLabel — Champagne Chain → Traceability Chain in all UI
intendedChain.test: RED: grep src/ for champagne (case-insensitive) → 0 hits in non-test/non-standard files. Open any detail-view → heading says Traceability Chain, NOT Champagne Chain. Currently FAILS (singular-chain.ts:3 says champagne).

architectDesign.scope: 3 files: singular-chain.ts (1 comment rename), detail-superseded.ts (check for "Champagne" heading strings), app.css (check for .champagne class names). Then node build.mjs to rebuild dist/.
steps: grep -rni champagne src/public/ts/ src/ts/ — identify all hits
singular-chain.ts:3 — rename comment "champagne path" → "traceability chain path"
detail-superseded.ts — check heading strings for "Champagne" → "Traceability Chain"
Any CSS class names .champagne-* → rename to .traceability-* if present
grep -rni champagne dist/ — verify 0 hits in compiled output
Tester: load /trace, open any detail → heading must say "Traceability Chain"
architectDesign.gate: grep -rni champagne src/public/ts/ src/ts/ → 0 hits (excluding test/standard files). Visual: detail-view heading = "Traceability Chain".
